name: -6 AN 90 Degree Female Aluminum Hose End (PTFE)
title: -6 AN 90 Degree Female Aluminum Hose End (PTFE)
description:
The -6 AN 90 Degree Female Aluminum Hose End (PTFE) is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings 90 Degree PTFE Female Aluminum Hose Ends are precision-engineered for high-pressure fuel, oil, coolant, brake, clutch, power steering, and E85 applications. Designed specifically for PTFE (Teflon-lined) braided hose, these PTFE fittings provide a secure, leak-free 37-degree flare seal for demanding street performance, racing, marine, and motorsport plumbing systems.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: Premium high-grade construction with corrosion-resistant coating.
• Flow Configuration: 90° mandrel-bent profile for high velocity in tight engine bays.
• Compatibility: Engineered specifically for PTFE hose. Impervious to E85, race gas, methanol, and power steering fluid.
